name: James Morris
source:
James is Mrs. Hudson's neighbor who fell in love with her and is always coming to the lodging house to persuade her to be a model for his paintings. He's a cheery young man, but he occasionally speaks and acts suspiciously. He might be hiding something.

[From the [url=http://hunex-play.com/portal/006/eng/index.html]official website[/url]]
